messages:
Maya Patel: quick sync from field — UniCare asked for eval-triggered alerts + an Optimize advisor that recommends batching, KV-cache TTLs, and quant profiles. They want a short pilot in July.
Samir Khan: two clear tracks: (A) alerts pipeline + webhook + runbook, (B) advisor engine + recommendation UI. Do we have capacity this quarter?
Jen Lee: recommend shipping alerts MVP first (simple threshold, per-tenant toggle, webhook) to limit blast radius and get signals.
Ravi Kumar: engineering notes: alerts need per-prompt eval hooks, sampling to avoid volume storms, rules engine with windowing. Advisor needs aggregated telemetry (p99, tokens, duplicate rate) and gated quant sims on a small GPU pool.
Alex Gomez: field ask — low false positives (<5%), explanation for every rec, and CSV export for audits. UniCare can provide a 2k labeled eval set and two eng-days.
Maya Patel: proposed acceptance gates: Alerts validated on a 5k prompt set with FP <= 5%, webhook + retry/backoff, ops playbook and alert-suppress flag. Advisor must output 3 ranked recs (batch size, kv-ttl, quant profile) with confidence and simulated >=10% cost savings on at least 2 sample workloads.
Samir Khan: rough effort: alerts MVP ~3 sprints (infra + QA + docs). Advisor offline sims + lightweight UI ~4 sprints. Shared work: telemetry pipeline and feature flags.
Jen Lee: UX: alert payload must include a one-line rationale, metric delta, 1-3 sample prompts, and an explicit next step (e.g., "increase batch to 8"). Include copy templates for customers.
Ravi Kumar: TTL heuristic sketch: if duplicate_rate > 0.2 and p99_latency < 150ms -> recommend_kv_ttl = min(600, dup_window) else recommend_kv_ttl = 0. Quant gating: run 100-shot eval; if quality_drop < 0.8% and latency_gain > 15% recommend int8. Surface confidence score; if <0.6 mark as "investigate".
Alex Gomez: UniCare requests a canary rollout to 5% tenants with auto rollback. Also require RBAC so only admins can apply recs.
Maya Patel: action items: Samir draft acceptance matrix by Wed EOD; Jen mock alert payload + CSV spec by Fri; Ravi prototype heuristics + sim plan by Tue. I'll request GPU budget and schedule the pilot kickoff.
Samir Khan: noted — I'll include alert latency SLA (emit <2s), webhook retry policy (3 attempts), and CSV export tests in the acceptance matrix.
Maya Patel: thanks all. I'll confirm UniCare's labeled set timeline and lock kickoff for next week.
